package moba

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/lockstep"
	svcmatch "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/match"
	"testing"
)

func draftRound(t *testing.T) Round {
	t.Helper()
	members := [ArenaSeats]Member{}
	for i := range members {
		members[i] = Member{PlayerID: int64(100 + i), SID: int32(1000 + i%2)}
	}
	r, err := NewRound(Change{Op: "init", HostSID: 2000, MatchID: "ranked-5v5", Members: members, Seed: 42, Deadline: 100, Now: 1})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return r
}
func playingRound(t *testing.T) Round {
	t.Helper()
	r := draftRound(t)
	var err error
	for i := range ArenaSeats {
		r, err = r.Update(Change{Op: "pick", HostSID: r.HostSID, Epoch: r.Epoch, Seat: i, Hero: i%5 + 1, Now: 2})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		r, err = r.Update(Change{Op: "ready", HostSID: r.HostSID, Epoch: r.Epoch, Seat: i, Ready: true, Now: 2})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	r, err = r.Update(Change{Op: "start", HostSID: r.HostSID, Epoch: r.Epoch, Now: 3})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return r
}
func arenaBot(f lockstep.FrameID, seat int) []byte {
	c := ArenaInput{Action: Attack, Target: byte((seat+5)%10 + 1)}
	if f <= 8 {
		c = ArenaInput{Action: Move, Step: 1, Lane: byte((seat % 5) % 3)}
		if seat >= 5 {
			c.Step = -1
		}
	} else if f%7 == 0 {
		c.Action = Cast
	}
	return c.Bytes()
}
func TestMOBAFivePlayerTeamsDraftAndMatchIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	store, err := svcmatch.NewMemoryStore(svcmatch.Config{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	q := svcmatch.Queue{Mode: "three-lanes", GroupSize: ArenaSeats, Partition: "cross-sid-business-route"}
	ids := []string{}
	for i := range ArenaSeats {
		ticket, err := store.Enqueue(ctx, q, svcmatch.Subject{Kind: "player", ID: int64(i + 1)}, fmt.Sprint(i))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		ids = append(ids, ticket.ID)
	}
	committed, err := store.Commit(ctx, q, ids)
	if err != nil || len(committed.Members) != ArenaSeats {
		t.Fatal("ten players not matched", err)
	}
	replay, err := store.Commit(ctx, q, ids)
	if err != nil || replay.ID != committed.ID {
		t.Fatal("match identity changed")
	}
	r := draftRound(t)
	change := func(op string, seat, hero int) error {
		var err error
		r, err = r.Update(Change{Op: op, Seat: seat, Hero: hero, HostSID: r.HostSID, Epoch: r.Epoch, Now: 2})
		return err
	}
	if change("start", 0, 0) == nil || change("ban", 1, 12) == nil {
		t.Fatal("draft started early / noncaptain banned")
	}
	if err := change("ban", 0, 12); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if change("pick", 0, 12) == nil {
		t.Fatal("banned hero picked")
	}
	if err := change("pick", 0, 1); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if change("pick", 1, 1) == nil {
		t.Fatal("duplicate team hero")
	}
	if err := change("pick", 5, 1); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("opponent mirror policy", err)
	}
	expired, err := r.Update(Change{Op: "expire", HostSID: r.HostSID, Epoch: r.Epoch, Now: 100})
	if err != nil || expired.Phase != "aborted" {
		t.Fatal("draft deadline not closed")
	}
	if _, err := expired.Awards(900); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	started := playingRound(t)
	if _, err := started.Update(Change{Op: "pick", HostSID: started.HostSID, Epoch: started.Epoch, Seat: 0, Hero: 2}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("roster changed after start")
	}
}
func applyArena(t *testing.T, a *Arena, inputs ...lockstep.Input) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := a.Apply(lockstep.Frame{ID: a.Tick + 1, Inputs: inputs}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func TestMOBAArenaTargetingThreeLanesEconomyAndRespawn(t *testing.T) {
	a := NewArena(42)
	a.Heroes[0].X = 15
	a.Heroes[0].HP = 100
	// 基地受塔保护；跨路 / 同队目标不造成伤害、不耗技能资源。
	hp := a.Bases[1]
	applyArena(t, a, lockstep.Input{Player: 1, Payload: ArenaInput{Action: Cast, Target: ArenaBase}.Bytes()})
	if a.Bases[1] != hp || a.Heroes[0].Mana != 20 {
		t.Fatal("base shield / invalid cast spent mana")
	}
	a.Heroes[5].X = 15
	a.Heroes[5].Lane = 1
	applyArena(t, a, lockstep.Input{Player: 1, Payload: ArenaInput{Action: Cast, Target: 6}.Bytes()})
	if a.Heroes[5].HP != 100 || a.Heroes[0].Mana != 20 {
		t.Fatal("cross-lane cast")
	}
	a.Heroes[0].X = 10
	a.Heroes[0].Lane = 1
	a.Heroes[5].X = 20
	for a.NeutralHP > 0 {
		applyArena(t, a, lockstep.Input{Player: 1, Payload: ArenaInput{Action: Attack, Target: ArenaNeutral}.Bytes()})
	}
	for i := range 5 {
		if a.Heroes[i].Gold != 15 || a.Heroes[i].BuffUntil <= a.Tick {
			t.Fatal("team objective reward missing")
		}
	}
	applyArena(t, a, lockstep.Input{Player: 1, Payload: ArenaInput{Action: Buy}.Bytes()})
	if a.Heroes[0].Items != 1 || a.Heroes[0].Gold != 10 {
		t.Fatal("shop did not debit")
	}
	a.Heroes[0].X = 10
	a.Heroes[5].X = 10
	a.Heroes[5].Lane = 1
	a.Heroes[5].HP = 1
	applyArena(t, a, lockstep.Input{Player: 1, Payload: ArenaInput{Action: Attack, Target: 6}.Bytes()})
	if a.Heroes[0].Kills != 1 || a.Heroes[5].HP != 0 {
		t.Fatal("kill missing")
	}
	reviveAt := a.Heroes[5].RespawnAt
	for a.Tick < reviveAt {
		applyArena(t, a)
	}
	if a.Heroes[5].HP != 100 || a.Heroes[5].X != 20 {
		t.Fatal("respawn missing")
	}
	// 三条塔各自归属，推中路不应解除边路保护。
	a.Heroes[0].Lane = 1
	a.Heroes[0].X = 15
	a.Heroes[0].HP = 100
	for a.Towers[1][1] > 0 {
		applyArena(t, a, lockstep.Input{Player: 1, Payload: ArenaInput{Action: Attack, Target: ArenaTower}.Bytes()})
	}
	if a.Towers[1][0] != 60 || a.Towers[1][2] != 60 {
		t.Fatal("one lane damaged other towers")
	}
	a.Heroes[0].X = 19
	for !a.Ended {
		applyArena(t, a, lockstep.Input{Player: 1, Payload: ArenaInput{Action: Attack, Target: ArenaBase}.Bytes()})
	}
	if a.Winner != 1 || a.Reason != "base" {
		t.Fatal("base victory missing")
	}
}
func TestMOBAArenaReplayVersionSeedAndFogBoundary(t *testing.T) {
	r := playingRound(t)
	if r.Reference.Visible(0, 5) {
		t.Fatal("unseen enemy visible")
	}
	for id := lockstep.FrameID(1); id <= 80; id++ {
		f := lockstep.Frame{ID: id}
		for i := range ArenaSeats {
			f.Inputs = append(f.Inputs, lockstep.Input{Player: lockstep.PlayerID(i + 1), Payload: arenaBot(id, i)})
		}
		var err error
		r, err = r.Update(Change{Op: "frame", HostSID: r.HostSID, Epoch: r.Epoch, Frame: f})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	restored, err := DecodeRound(r.Encode())
	if err != nil || restored.Reference.Digest() != r.Reference.Digest() {
		t.Fatal("checkpoint / journal mismatch", err)
	}
	original := r.Reference.Digest()
	r.Reference.Heroes[0].Gold++
	if _, err := DecodeRound(r.Encode()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("tampered snapshot accepted")
	}
	r.Reference.Heroes[0].Gold--
	r.Version = "other-rules"
	if _, err := DecodeRound(r.Encode()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("unknown configuration accepted")
	}
	r.Version = ArenaVersion
	r.InitialSeed++
	if _, err := DecodeRound(r.Encode()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("changed seed accepted")
	}
	if r.Reference.Digest() != original {
		t.Fatal("replay modified reference")
	}
	bad := lockstep.Frame{ID: r.Reference.Tick + 1, Inputs: []lockstep.Input{{Player: 1, Payload: ArenaInput{Action: Move, Step: 1}.Bytes()}, {Player: 2, Payload: []byte{255}}}}
	if err := r.Reference.Apply(bad); err == nil || r.Reference.Digest() != original {
		t.Fatal("bad frame partially applied")
	}
}
func TestMOBAArenaSurrenderAndTimeLimit(t *testing.T) {
	a := NewArena(42)
	votes := []lockstep.Input{}
	for i := range 4 {
		votes = append(votes, lockstep.Input{Player: lockstep.PlayerID(i + 1), Payload: ArenaInput{Action: ArenaSurrender}.Bytes()})
	}
	applyArena(t, a, votes...)
	if !a.Ended || a.Winner != 2 || a.Reason != "surrender" {
		t.Fatal("four-member surrender missing")
	}
	if err := a.Apply(lockstep.Frame{ID: 2}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("terminal arena advanced")
	}
	a = NewArena(42)
	for !a.Ended {
		applyArena(t, a)
	}
	if a.Tick != MaxFrames || a.Winner != 0 || a.Reason != "time_limit" {
		t.Fatal("time-limit result incorrect")
	}
}
